title: Switch Statement
subStepTitle: Things to Know in C++/Java/Python or any language
intro: Switch/case shines for discrete labels. Know fall-through rules in C++/Java/Go versus Python’s if-elif style, and always cover the default path. Classic framing from the roadmap note “switch case statements”.
intuition: Map each discrete case to a branch; default handles “anything else.”

python.code:
d = int(input())
# Python has no switch historically; use dict or match (3.10+)
match d:
    case 1: print("mon")
    case 2: print("tue")
    case _: print("other")
